resources.string: This file is too big, or is not plain text, for the commands of the router.
Large files go over SFTP, and SSH is turned off on the router.
Large files go over SFTP, and port %1$d of SSH does not answer.
Large files go over SFTP, and this connection has no SSH.
The SSH host key was not accepted, so large files do not go.
The file is bigger than rpcd gives (256 KiB), and SSH is not available.
On OpenWrt SSH is turned on in System → Administration (Dropbear).
Turn on SSH on the router
Turn on the SSH service of the router? Files of any size will go over SFTP afterwards.
